about.title: About us
about.body1: We build focused AI modules for retail and services: real-time metrics, instant customer responses outside office hours, and automation for sales and marketing instead of manual follow-up.
about.body2: Each module has a clear rollout path with Zalo, Telegram, TikTok and Facebook integrations so you see value early and scale step by step. Alongside client work, Lynx AI Solution directly owns and operates its own retail brand, Chom Chom Studio, on TikTok Shop — where we run our own products before packaging them for clients.

chomchom.title: Chom Chom Studio — internal TikTok Shop dashboard
chomchom.desc: Lynx AI Solution owns and operates the women's fashion brand Chom Chom Studio (chomchom.com.vn), selling on TikTok Shop under the company's own advertiser account. We built the internal reporting dashboard that reads data through the TikTok Business API: daily GMV Max revenue and ad spend, ROI per campaign and per video, inventory by SKU, ad wallet balance — and manages that same account's GMV Max campaigns.
chomchom.result: Covers only the company's own advertiser account · internal use, no data shared with third parties

crm.title: Customer management system (CRM 360°)
crm.desc: Centralizes multi-channel customer data, automates segmentation, tracks the sales pipeline and measures campaign performance in real time.
crm.result: Higher conversion rate · better customer retention

zalo.title: Zalo Sales Data Management
zalo.desc: Syncs and manages all Zalo OA conversation data — sales assignment, automated follow-up reminders, order tracking and per-agent KPI measurement.
zalo.result: No lost leads · better close rate

why.title: Why choose us
points: One platform, many modules: reporting, CS, sales and marketing connected instead of fragmented tools.
We use our own products: we operate our own retail brand on TikTok Shop, so we understand e-commerce and advertising problems from the inside.
Built for Vietnam channels: Zalo, Telegram, TikTok and Reels in the default rollout.
See before you buy: demo videos per module so you know features and automation depth.
After go-live: we tune prompts, playbooks and reports to your real operations.
